text:
Ava: quick heads-up — discovered a mismatch in the hello quickstart auth snippet, causing 401s when folks try the first deploy.
Ben: which file?
Ava: docs/quickstart/hello.md, the example exports `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` but the SDK examples use `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
Carmen: oh dang. that explains the noisy support threads.
Darren: can we fix both the bash snippet and the TS/py SDK examples in one PR? also add a tiny smoke test so CI catches regressions.
Ava: yep. proposed patch outline:
```bash
# example to run locally
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-xxxx
python examples/hello/hello.py
```
Ben: also update the TS example to: 
```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
```
Carmen: I'll open a docs PR and include an `examples/hello/auth_smoke.sh` that does a token check and exits non-zero on auth failure. I'll link the PR here.
Ava: please also add a short note in the quickstart troubleshooting section: "If you see 401 immediately, check env var name and token format."
Darren: when you open the PR, add me and Ava as reviewers, and tag `@eng` for the quick runtime snippet sanity check.
Carmen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — includes corrected snippets, smoke script, and a tiny CI step that runs the script in the docs job.
Ben: LGTM from me pending smoke CI pass. I verified the TS and py snippets locally.
Ava: CI for PR 482 is green for the docs build, smoke step passed. thanks @Carmen :tada:
deploy-bot: docs build succeeded for PR #482 (job: docs-ci, duration: 2m 18s)
Darren: rolling this into the next docs minor release notes. I'll add a one-liner under "Quickstart fixes".
Ava: great — can we also sweep other quickstarts for env var consistency? maybe a tiny script to grep for both names and flag mismatches.
Carmen: on it. I'll add a follow-up issue to track the sweep and assign to docs squad.
Ava: awesome. closing this thread after merge. thanks everyone.
